prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1078; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you the details of what happened, if that's all right.

Q: That's fine. We'll get to the details. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle you were operating at the time?

A: Yes, I was driving my own car.

Q: Where exactly did the collision occur?

A: It was in a shopping center parking lot in Sugar Land, near the main entrance. I was pulling out of a space in the middle row.

Q: What time of day was it?

A: It was in the afternoon, maybe around three or so, and the lot was fairly busy.

Q: Describe how the collision happened.

A: I was backing out slowly, looking over my shoulder. Another vehicle came down the aisle and its rear corner clipped the back of my car. I stopped right away. I don't think either of us was going very fast.

Q: Did you have any contact with the other driver afterward?

A: Briefly. We exchanged information and they seemed apologetic.

Q: How are you feeling since the collision?

A: My neck is really stiff, and I've had headaches. Turning my head to check mirrors hurts. The doctor said it looks like whiplash.

Q: Have you received any treatment so far?

A: Yes, I've been going to physical therapy twice a week and I'm taking anti-inflammatory medication.

Q: Did you have any neck or back problems before this collision?

A: Not that I'm aware of. I'd been fine.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I'd like the claim handled as quickly as possible, since the treatment is costing me time off work.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
